items.statement: The investigation generates and documents multiple TsCl–THF arrangements, deduplicates them, and validates retained minima before excited-state work.
items.expected: Candidate identities, geometry provenance, deduplication context, and minimum checks are present for the investigated set.

items.statement: The selected candidate is subjected to an independent vertical-excitation calculation and CT assignment analysis.
items.expected: A state-specific wavelength, oscillator strength, method, and donor/acceptor evidence are reported.

items.statement: The computed allowed excitation is consistent with the visible absorption observed for TsCl in THF.
items.expected: Reported excitation lies in or is explicitly compared with the 365–400 nm experimental band.

items.statement: The relevant excitation has solvent-to-TsCl CT character involving THF oxygen donation and an S–Cl antibonding acceptor.
items.expected: The conclusion identifies a THF-to-TsCl CT assignment and supports it with orbital/population or density evidence.
